name: Princess Knight☆Catue ~Ochita Ryuuki Hime~
original_name: プリンセスナイト☆カチュア ～堕ちた竜騎姫～
source:
See the stout dragoon princess as an outcast among the demon tribe, and in the end also having her fellow humans forcing themselves upon her!

With too much faith and too little doubt in mankind, she gets gangbanged by her very own servants...
Screaming for breath, her virginity is taken by an ugly pig at the hands of the demon tribe...
Tentacles crawling all over her, and planting their seed inside her...
And then, she is violated by her mother, who had also fallen to the demon tribe!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE033066.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
身为魔族弃儿的粗壮龙骑公主，最终还被人类同胞强加于她！

由于对人类抱有太多的信心和太少的怀疑，她被自己的仆人轮奸了……
尖叫着喘不过气来，她的童贞被魔族手中的一头丑猪夺走……
触手在她身上爬行，并将种子种在她体内……
然后，她又被同样堕入魔族的母亲侵犯了！
